mission: Ben and Talon cross storm-exposed gantries and sea-wall system while pursued. Ben protects people; Talon gets them to a skiff or shuttle. They escape Tarn Velos. The First Plot Point lands here: Ben has crossed a threshold he cannot uncross. He has broken cover, freed a convicted prisoner, generated a public crisis, and committed himself to the case in a way that makes returning to the way things were impossible. The forced partnership with Talon is the new condition of his life.
why_now: Chapter 9 occupies the first_plot_point phase and carries the next locked outline turn.
conflict: The escape should feel costly, not triumphant. Ben knows what he has just done. Talon knows what Ben has just done for him and is not yet sure what it will cost either of them.
turning_point: They escape Tarn Velos, but the legal mess is now unavoidable.
closing_hook: They escape Tarn Velos, but the legal mess is now unavoidable.
setting: Tarn Velos sea-wall system — storm-exposed gantries above the breaking surf, wind hammering sideways, transparisteel panels rattling in their frames. Beyond the gantries, the cliff drop into a churning sea. Ben and Talon cross to a maintenance skiff. The escape is costly and ugly, not triumphant.
emotional_trajectory: The escape should feel costly, not triumphant. Ben knows what he has just done. Talon knows what Ben has just done for him and is not yet sure what it will cost either of them.
